easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Yannik until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
